svg.title: Selected work
svg.desc: AI Receptionist: Multi-tenant SaaS with billing, analytics and RLS, plus a voice agent.; WriteFlow: Roles, rich text, media, comments and admin, on serverless Postgres.; FixMyResume: JWT-secured Django API at 100+ RPM behind React; LLM scoring on top.; Intervexa: Auth, billing and a live code runner around adaptive mock interviews.; YT2Notes: Google OAuth, transcripts and saved study notes.; DataStory AI: S3 uploads, a FastAPI analysis service, scrollytelling charts.

g.text: A multi-tenant SaaS for 12 business verticals: call logs,
scheduling, analytics and billing, secured with PII
encryption and Postgres row-level security. A voice agent
on top books, waitlists and escalates.
NEXT.JS / SUPABASE / POSTGRES RLS / RETELL AI
Auth, billing and a live code
